newsitem.title: USA: Daktronics Q3 hurt by timing of contracts.
newsitem.headline: Daktronics Q3 hurt by timing of contracts.

text.p: Daktronics Inc attributed its lower February 1 third-quarter sales to the timing of receipt of various contracts awaiting customer design approval.
It also cited delivery of parts from various suppliers.
The company said the loss it posted in the quarter was the result of lower-than-expected sales.

For the quarter, Daktronics, which designs and sells a variety of computer-programmable information display systems, posted a loss of $0.02 per share. Sales declined to $11.5 million from $12.6 million in the same year-earlier period.
